objects.name: Analytic 2208
objects.description: Monitor OPC UA server audit events for state-changing Write or Method service invocations and compare ClientUserId, ClientApplicationUri, SourceNode/MethodId, status, and arguments with the approved client/method baseline. For servers that support auditing, AuditWriteUpdateEventType and AuditUpdateMethodEventType provide an analyst-visible record of writes and state-changing method calls. Alert on successful or attempted control operations from unapproved clients/users or against methods/nodes outside the documented engineering workflow; do not describe this as Windows OS API telemetry.
